name: Roommates
overview: Four bachelor friends navigate the chaotic challenges of job hunting, career stress, and overbearing landlords in Bengaluru. Their daily struggles turn into a hilarious rollercoaster of friendship, survival, and unexpected comedy as they hustle to make it big.
